amends: protocol.json and amendment_hardware_scope.json (same directory). Written before any hardware run and before the twin is re-run under it.
decided_by: user (512 MB cards only; no card swapping or multi-phase schedule; raw data must be injected as int16 to match a real 16-bit IMU)

sd_content.representation: raw vibration samples as int16, one float32 scale per (acquisition, channel) = max|x|/32767 (1.0 if max|x| == 0), q = roundf(x/scale) (half away from zero), clip [-32767, 32767]. Every acquisition of every hardware machine (train, calibration, healthy test, unhealthy test, unscored) is stored raw; nothing precomputed is used by the board for detection.
sd_content.on_device: streaming float32 feature extraction (research/hardware_twin_scaling_20260929/raw_features_f32.py is the reference), per-stream standardisation, H12 training, int8 exchange, scoring, 13-of-21, alarms
sd_content.self_check_file: each card also carries the twin's float32 22-D raw (pre-standardisation) features for that machine's train + calibration rows, used only to report the on-device extractor's max deviation; the board must not use them in the pipeline

hardware_eligibility.rule: a machine is hardware-eligible iff its full int16 raw size (all rows, streams, channels; from results/hardware_twin_scaling_20260929/raw/inventory.csv sd_bytes_float32 / 2) <= 496 MB / 3 = 165.33 MB, so any 3 eligible machines fit one 512 MB card (496 MB usable)
hardware_eligibility.disclosure: The hardware set excludes the 13 longest recordings for storage reasons. This is a selection on recording length, stated as such in the thesis; the simulation covers all 54.

machine_order_v2.construction: apply protocol.json machine_order.construction (rng default_rng(20260929), datasets in sorted name order, machines sorted by machine_id then shuffled within dataset, round-robin interleave) to the 41 eligible machines -> positions 0-40; then apply the same construction with a fresh default_rng(20260929) to the 13 ineligible machines -> positions 41-53
machine_order_v2.levels: unchanged: 4, 8, ... 52, 54. Hardware levels 4-28 (all eligible, <= 3 per board). Levels >= 32 simulation-only.

twin: re-run run_twin under machine_order_v2 for every level x mode x seed. The twin's x for every machine is computed from the int16-quantised raw with the streaming float32 extractor, so the twin reads the same bytes as the boards. The float64 fl.Server reference on the committed cache x is reported alongside at every level.

gates_before_cards_are_written.G1_int16_accuracy: on the level-28 v2 set and the full 54, with the float64 model trained on the committed cache: int16-derived x gives strict >= committed-x strict - 1 on every seed, and at most 1 scored machine changes outcome per seed
gates_before_cards_are_written.G2_twin_v2: twin (int16 x) strict >= float64 (committed x) strict - 1 at every level and seed, both modes
gates_before_cards_are_written.G3_fit: every card's total bytes (raw + scales + headers + self-check file + manifest) <= 496 MB
